t: Quick-bonding solution that fills and bonds the gap to make Rawlplugs fit tight. For walls that are too crumbly to support a new plug and screw. No need to re-drill, no preparation, no special tools and no mess. Just wet the disc, wrap around the plug and push into the hole. Supplied in card/paper packaging suitable for kerbside recycling.
b: Suitable for Concrete, Brickwork, Stone, Blockwork & Plasterboard
Supplied in Kerbside Recyclable Card/Paper Packaging
